@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions a REKKI alternative, or something to add?

acceptedAnswer.text: One to add, not swap. REKKI automates the work your office does on orders that have already arrived, plus the inbox and the upselling. We change the way one group of customers orders, so less of that work exists. REKKI's robots can stay on the rest.

@graph.name: Is the voice app more accurate than REKKI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not in those terms. Our safeguard is different: every line is picked from the account's guide and the buyer checks each one before sending. Theirs measures how well a machine reads an order a person wrote. That is a different kind of check, not a better percentage.

@graph.name: So can an order still be wrong?

acceptedAnswer.text: Of course. Somebody can confirm the wrong quantity, as they can on any order ever placed. What changes is who reads the lines last: the person who wants the goods, before anything leaves. This only covers orders placed in our app: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no number, no timestamp and nothing moving against stock.

@graph.name: Does your app connect to REKKI?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. There is no link between the two and no joint support. OrderAI keeps passing what it reads into your system, and our orders come separately, emailed as a file or sent in over EDI or the API.

@graph.name: Some of our customers already use the REKKI app. What happens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nothing breaks. Their chef app is free and, by their own account, sends orders to suppliers whether or not the supplier signed up, converting them to email for your order address. Those keep arriving as they do now. Give our app to the accounts who prefer speaking to typing, and leave the ones already happy where they are.

They are more open here than we are, and that deserves saying: their site carries an opening figure per customer and what it includes. It is quoted in pounds, and their marketplace is described as UK only, while the app itself is described as working anywhere in the world. Ours is quote-based and nothing is published, so ask and you will get a figure for the voice step on its own.

@graph.name: How fast could this be running?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most distributors are running it in 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens have an order in that day. Nothing in REKKI is touched or rewired, which matters if you came looking for a REKKI alternative with only one problem to settle.

@graph.name: Where do the REKKI details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Taken from rekki.com, as of 10 October 2026: the robot descriptions, the accuracy and training wording, the published starting price and the chef app questions. Their performance figures are their own and are not quoted here as results. If any of it has moved on, the mistake is at our end.
